alex: Kicking off prod deploy for service-api v2.3.0 now — change window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Running the health-check runbook. deploy-bot: Deploy triggered by alex at 2025-03-14T22:00:05Z. Preflight checks: infra ok, smoke tests ok. sam: thanks — i'll watch the SLO dashboards (links below) and hold the rollback lane open. maria: I'm oncall, ping me if p95 > 350ms or error budget burn > 5% within 10m. eric: Heads-up: I pushed a short-lived tracing patch to the dashboard, should show request traces for /v1/generate. deploy-bot: Autoscaler warmup started (2 -> 8 instances). Expected steady-state in ~3m. alex: rolling traffic to v2.3.0 canary 10% -> 50% now. Watching 2xx and 5xx rates. sam: querying p95 over last 5m

```
service:service-api p95(latency, 5m) by {route}
```

sam: p95 for /v1/generate jumped to 420ms at +4m, small tail of 502s creeping up (0.3% -> 0.9%). maria: seeing a small error-rate bump on the SLO panel, error budget delta +3.2% (5m). eric: tracing shows a specific slow heatmap on gpu-host-12, KV cache miss rate higher. deploy-bot: Canary at 50% applied. Health checks: 502 count trend crossing threshold 0.8%.

alex: pause rollout at 60% and start mitigation checklist. sam: paused, rolling back the 60% step. deploy-bot: Rollout paused by alex at 2025-03-14T22:12:14Z. alex: quick check — is this consistent across regions or just eu-west-1? eric: looks concentrated in eu-west-1; us-east is fine. GPU host scheduling spike correlated with kernel upgrade on that fleet. maria: propose pinning eu-west-1 to previous instance profile and continue global rollout excluding eu-west-1. alex: aggree, that keeps overall availability while we fix region.

sam: action items:
- pin eu-west-1 traffic to v2.2.9 (previous stable)
- resume rollout to rest of regions to 80%
- open incident if eu-west still >1% 5xx in 15m

maria: i'll run the pin now. deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: eu-west-1 -> v2.2.9 (100%), others -> v2.3.0 (80%). alex: resuming global rollout to 80%. sam: monitoring p95 and 5xx; p95 back to 310ms global, eu-west still showing ~1.1% 5xx. maria: filing an infra ticket to rollback kernel on gpu-host group in eu-west-1, tagging infra-oncall. eric: created tracing span filter and left notes: span_id=span-8f9, root cause looks like NV kernel jitter after upgrade.

deploy-bot: Canary step complete, overall health: degraded in eu-west-1 only. alex: decision: continue rollout with eu-west excluded, open postmortem for eu-west kernel upgrade, and plan to rollback kernel there. sam: agree. maria: i'll coordinate infra rollback and keep this thread updated. eric: will add a regression alert to prevent auto-rollouts after kernel changes next time.

sam: final check at +40m: global 5xx at 0.12%, p95 298ms. eu-west still 1.0% 5xx -> infra rollback queued. alex: thanks team. We'll tag release notes: "v2.3.0: feature X, performance improvements; note: EU region temporarily pinned to v2.2.9 due to infra kernel issue, rollout resumed elsewhere." deploy-bot: Deploy window closed for v2.3.0 at 2025-03-14T22:47:79Z. :white_check_mark:
